name: @verikit/cli
description: Scaffolding CLI for VeriKit  detects your stack, installs the right packages, and wires up the integration.
author: Chidi E <hi@ceeso.dev>

scripts.test: rm -rf .test-dist && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test $(find ./.test-dist/test -name '*.test.js' -type f | sort)
scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf .test-dist coverage && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=100 --test-coverage-branches=100 --test-coverage-functions=100 $(find ./.test-dist/test -name '*.test.js' -type f | sort)
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm format:check && pnpm test:coverage
